name: argo-rollouts
description: kubectl plugin for Argo Rollouts — progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) inspection, promote, abort and dashboard

install_steps: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install rollouts (binary lands as kubectl-argo-rollouts on PATH)
Or download kubectl-argo-rollouts for your platform from https://github.com/argoproj/argo-rollouts/releases and move it to PATH
